title: Race Info — RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town 2026
claims: The official race-information page sets minimum ages of 16 for Kickstarter 16, 18 for Explorer 23 and 20 for Table Mountain 35, Peninsula Traverse 55, UT100 and the 100 miler.
Runners must carry all compulsory gear for the entire race, whichever distance they enter.
The race is cupless; runners must carry their own cup.
A runner who leaves the marked course for any reason must return on foot, and a runner who needs to withdraw must continue to the nearest aid station and inform the station captain.
Leaving the course without notifying race officials can lead to a ban from future participation, unless first-aid crews assist the runner off the course.
Medical attention is available but may not be immediately on hand; runners heading to an aid station for more than basic first aid should alert the emergency contact first.

verification.note: Official race-information page read directly on 2026-11-20. Age limits, compulsory gear, cupless rule, DNF procedure and medical wording are on the page.
